headline: Ridge Road residents described speeding and cut-through traffic; the chief said the street is on the traffic division's enforcement schedule.
summary: Public speakers said cars speed and pass stop signs on Ridge Road, and one said a parked truck was hit and cost $1,500 to fix. The chief said some traffic ideas still need review. The board approved asking for six more officers, raising authorized staffing from 124 to 130. It also approved a $50,000 transfer from contingency for fleet motor vehicle service.
decisions: Approved a $50,000 transfer from contingency for fleet motor vehicle service.
Approved applying for a $25,350 Bulletproof Best grant, with a $12,675 local match.
Referred the automated traffic enforcement review position to the salary committee.
Approved increasing authorized police staffing by six officers, from 124 to 130.
Approved including a police fleet maintenance position in the upcoming budget.
discussion: Ridge Road speeding and traffic: Public speakers said cars speed and pass stop signs and school buses on the street, and that a car nearly hit one speaker. The chief said Ridge Road is on the traffic division's routine enforcement schedule, with at least a monthly presence.

Police staffing report: The chief said the report recommends 249 officers under a cost-for-service model and 130 under a 60 percent model. Members asked about the other recommendations, and the chief said those need more time.
License plate cameras: The chief said nine of the 14 planned cameras will be cut, for a savings of about $27,000 a year. The department is moving away from Flock.

Automated traffic cameras: The update said the contract with site stream, the winning bidder, is at signing, and cameras could come in early spring. School bus warnings run through December 7, and then $250 tickets begin.

Vision Zero: A regional program aims to reduce serious crashes by 2046. A referral from a West End meeting asks the traffic division to look at adding a left-turn arrow from northbound West Street onto South.
